notes.title: ＜CC: MNG RPG Release Celebration＞ Collect and feed Cookies to get rewards!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34055295/4b84d3d8884ebb56af071be5504a529c667ffa08.png[/img]

Well, the time has finally come! It's the moment you've all been waiting for! I'm not even going to waste your time with the usual introductory spiel! Let's get into it!

Moe! Ninja Girls RPG has been let loose into the world! What a time to be alive! Have you already downloaded and started playing it?

And just in time for the occasion, we've got a very special Cookie Collection for you faithful fans still checking in on us while the new hotness is out! We know how tempting the new girls are, which is why we've arranged for them to appear in this new scenario! You can expect the usual hijinx in this special crossover event!

In addition, we've added a new set of login bonuses to collect, so don't forget to pay us a visit every now and then!

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
COOKIE COLLECTION: Moe! Ninja Girls RPG Release Celebration
Early Bird Special Period Ends: Jun. 7, 8 PM (PST)
Event Ends: Jun. 20, 8 PM (PST)
